panels.description: Shows the percentage of CPU actively used on each host, calculated as 100 - %idle over the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: CPU Utilization for every Host (Current)

panels.description: Shows the percentage of CPU currently in use per instance, calculated as 100 - %idle over the last 15 minutes. This provides a 15-minute rolling average of CPU utilization across the system.
panels.title: CPU Utilization per Host (15-min Avg)

panels.description: This panel shows the percentage of time the disk spent doing write operations averagedover the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: Disk Write Utilization (%)

panels.description: This panel shows the percentage of time the disk spent doing read operations averaged over the last 5 minutes.
panels.title: Disk Read Utilization (%)

panels.description: This panel shows total number of filesystem or device errors across all monitored disks and partitions for each server
panels.title: File System Device Error
Current Disk I/O for each host

panels.description: Shows the amount of free disk space available on the specified mount points for each host instance. This metric helps monitor storage capacity and detect low-disk conditions that may impact database performance or availability.
panels.title: Free Disk Space(Host View) For Mount Point  - $HostMountPoints

panels.description: Shows the amount of free disk space available on all filesystem devices for the selected host instance. This metric helps track storage usage and identify when a host is running low on available disk space, which can affect database performance, logging, and overall system stability.
panels.title: Free Disk Space (Device View) for Host - $HostList

panels.description: Displays the total number of workfile spill files and total spill size (in bytes) for each segment in the cluster.
panels.title: Spill File Usage per Segment

panels.description: Shows the top 20 queries generating workfile spills in the cluster.  If no active spill queries exist, a placeholder row is shown to indicate zero spill activity.
panels.title: Top Queries by Spill Usage
